propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently completes all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time with PlanReviewCancelledStale, wasting computation on invalidated checkpoints keyed by the original material fingerprint.

The cancellation mechanism must detect own-material changes at exactly two seams (between finders and verify, and between decide and coach) without keying on relation snapshot or tracker HEAD, to avoid reintroducing false cancellations on unrelated ticket writes (d70a regression).

The cancel signal must be an out-of-band token checked before recovery paths in produce_plan_review_verdict, because a step failure alone would be recovered into a findings verdict that advances the store revision via sidecar.emit.

When own material changes are detected mid-run, the review returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding and exits with code 2, skipping floors, signing, and sidecar emission.

The probe reads current material via attest.current_material_fingerprint under local_read_context to avoid fetch/reconverge or sync-lock acquisition, and in-flight _chunk calls check review_cancelled() before runner invocation.
With no mid-run edits, plan review behavior and verdict outputs remain byte-identical to pre-change baseline, and mid-run writes to unrelated tickets do not trigger cancellation.
